title: 目標達成の後に・我等が目指すは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Spring comes, and with it the classic-year G1 races. Mejiro Ardan proposes that we set the Japanese Derby as her ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Behind her proposal lies a powerful desire to shine so brightly that she expels the shadow of her legendary older sister. She hopes to leave her own dazzling mark on the present, as Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I set the Aoba Sho as a preliminary race in the hopes of increasing her chances, however little, of winning the Japanese Derby. With our minds made up, we start to make progress once again. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan has taken notice of the growing success of Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki during their classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After putting this out of mind, though, she reaffirms that her primary goal is to outshine her older sister's accomplishments, then refocuses on the Aoba Sho…
